theme_strategy.description: Industrial control room dashboard. Absolute clarity, high data density, Swiss brutalist layout with extreme weight contrast. Avoid decorative elements. Focus on functional status colors.

typography.rules: Use mono font for all numbers, KPIs, and tabular data for perfect vertical alignment. Never center-align tabular data; always left-align text and right-align numbers.

layout_spacing.grid_system: Control Room Grid (Mode B). Dense, rigid layout using CSS Grid. 12-column base for desktops.
layout_spacing.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Rely on 1px solid borders to delineate space. Do not use drop shadows in dark mode.

AppShell.description: Left sidebar (w-64) for primary navigation. Top bar containing breadcrumbs, Light/Dark toggle, and global platform status. Main content area scrolls independently.
AppShell.layout: flex h-screen overflow-hidden bg-background text-text_primary font-sans

KpiCard.description: Used for GVF, WLR, GOR, IAJ Score.
KpiCard.classes: border border-border bg-surface p-4 flex flex-col gap-1 rounded-sm

EnvelopeChart.description: GVF x WLR scatter map using recharts.
EnvelopeChart.implementation: ScatterPlot over custom SVG reference areas. Zones: Apta (Green tint), Restrita (Amber tint), Bloqueada (Red tint). Plot the actual trajectory connecting historical windows.

ComparisonCard.description: Compares Subsea/Topside/Separador/FCS320. Must display absolute and relative deviations.
ComparisonCard.classes: grid grid-cols-4 gap-4 p-4 border border-border bg-surface rounded-sm text-sm

StatusBadge.description: Traceability and metrological status indicators. No gradients.
StatusBadge.classes: px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider border rounded-sm inline-flex items-center justify-center

MemorialDrawer.description: Right-side collapsible panel for RCA, Technical Opinion, and Auditable Memorial.
MemorialDrawer.classes: w-96 border-l border-border bg-surface h-full overflow-y-auto

DataTable.description: For PVT/EOS Lab samples and historical windows.

motion.strategy: Utilitarian and minimalist. Instant feedback. Limit animations to < 150ms opacity fades. Avoid translation (sliding) animations to prevent motion sickness in offshore environments.

testing.requirements: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, toggles, badges) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case.

media.instructions: Do not use third-party logos or stock photos. Rely purely on typography, layout, and icon-based data representation.

instructions_to_main_agent: Write all React components as standard .js or .jsx files. Do not use .tsx files.
Implement a robust 'Control Room Grid' with dense data presentation. Use 'p-4' inside cards instead of standard 'p-6' to fit more data.
Enforce high contrast. Ensure text readability against backgrounds in both dark and light modes.
Include a functional Dark/Light mode toggle in the header.
For the EnvelopeChart, use Recharts and overlay the scatter data on top of distinct background zones (Apta, Restrita, Bloqueada) using pure shapes/colors.
Never use Teal green/blue. Never use generic purple gradients. Stick to the defined status colors.
For the K-Factors (Ko, Kg, Kw, Khc, Kt) section, display the factors alongside an explicit 'Requer aprovação' action/status.
All components must be accessible and include data-testid for automated testing.
Avoid Shadcn 'Card' wrapper if it introduces uncontrollable padding; prefer native 'div' with border/bg utilities for precise density control.
